extra_instruction: This is a real-data collection run for WorkflowIR research. Preserve query failures, zero-result queries, over-broad queries, API failures, blocked states, retries, and any recovery decisions in SUMMARY.md. Do not hide mistakes; they are the dataset.

trials.name: workflowir_tool_contracts
trials.topic: typed tool contracts for LLM agents, including schemas, preconditions, effects, workflow IR, static validation, and tool-call failure prevention

trials.name: agent_error_recovery_attribution
trials.topic: LLM agent error recovery and failure attribution in multi-tool workflows, including tool failure localization, counterexample-guided repair, retry policies, and trace diagnostics

trials.name: academic_search_agent_failures
trials.topic: AI agents for academic literature search, citation verification, evidence grounding, search query planning, recall failures, and hallucinated references

trials.name: workflow_planning_benchmarks
trials.topic: benchmarks for tool-using LLM agents that evaluate DAG planning, executable workflows, API-tool selection, dependency edges, and exact-match workflow plans

trials.name: tool_use_runtime_observability
trials.topic: observability, telemetry, tracing, monitoring, and debugging for LLM tool-use runtimes and agent workflow execution
